events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 30 (yesterday)): Fronge added Skyy Moore (WR, GB) for $1 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 30 (yesterday)): Wingard added Josh Cameron (WR, JAX) (dropped AJ Dillon (RB, CAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 30 (yesterday)): Wingard added Case Keenum (QB, CHI) (dropped Cooper Rush (QB, ATL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 30 (yesterday)): Drew added DJ Herman (RB, MIA) for $1 FAAB (dropped DJ Giddens (RB, IND)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 30 (yesterday)): Drew added CJ Donaldson (RB, NO) (dropped Tai Felton (WR, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 29 (2 days ago)): Adam added Kendre Miller (RB, NO) for $32 FAAB (dropped Jordan James (RB, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 29 (2 days ago)): Adam added Konata Mumpfield (WR, LAR) for $61 FAAB (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 27 (4 days ago)): Charles added Isaiah Williams (WR, NYJ).

WEEK 3 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Drew, 161.3-93.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Adam, 114.7-98.8; Wingard def. Fronge, 121.8-99.4; Charles def. Brent, 174.0-89.1 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Jake, 139.5-123.2; Kevin def. Shaq, 148.6-117.4

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 6-0 with 548.5 points scored and CROWN is at $136.79. Ryan walks into that building this week at 3-3. The exchange knows what's coming. The only question is whether the scoreboard is as merciless as the standings suggest.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Eight and four on the season, locks two-for-two, and I want everyone to sit with the fact that Terrence is at five and seven. Five. And seven. That is not a slump, that is a worldview problem. I want a segment and I want Terrence in the chair across from me.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Adam-Jake matchup this week is genuinely unpredictable and I am treating that as an asset. HLX has cycled through four players in a week. ECHO just dropped a game to Mitchum. My model loves uncertainty. Ask me again Sunday night.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Wingard added Case Keenum AND Josh Cameron off waivers yesterday and is somehow the more functional side of the Drew matchup this week. SDR at $65.03 and the most exciting thing on the roster is a quarterback who last started meaningful games during a different presidential administration.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Fronge's Havana relocation as a red flag in July and now FORG is at $78.62, second-worst on the active board, 2-4, and Wingard just beat them last week. The regulatory flexibility is not showing up in the win column. I called it.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley put up 161 on Drew last week and is now sitting at $123.00 on the exchange — up 3.1% — heading into a Week 4 date with Brent, who scored 89 in a loss. Apex is the second-best record in this league and the desk still can't figure out if they have a real QB. That matters eventually.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: People keep asking me why Kevin is ranked where he is and I keep pointing at 413 points in six weeks for a team that inherited a trust deficit and a hollowed-out roster. Redline at $82.84 while sitting fourth in the league is the most misprice on the board right now and it is not particularly close.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger's Week 4 preview notes: a 6-0 team hosting the defending champion, an 0-6 team that has now made four moves in a month, and a pundit board where the gap between first and last is six picks. Thursday is going to be a busy morning in this building.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Seven and five, locks two-for-two, and I have watched Brent lose by 85 points while OBS climbs 13.9% to $75.32 on the exchange. The market has decided Bowers is a time bomb and is buying the fuse. Corbishley gets Brent this week and I know exactly which side of that game I am on.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: ATLAS 0-6. Drew added DJ Herman AND CJ Donaldson in the same 48-hour window. Two new backs, zero wins, and a stock price that is still the cheapest non-SDR listing on the board at $49.72 despite a 9.1% bounce. The rebuild is moving. The rebuild is not working.
